messages:
rulia: flagging an odd billing-preview pattern from this morning. small customers saw sudden route attribution flips after the priority-router change.
marco: saw that too. any raw traces? guessing enrichment/key-mapping race.
tia: putting a trace sample here (redacted ids):
```
2026-03-20T09:11:10.451Z INFO request=Zq77 router=priority-fast decision=optimistic
2026-03-20T09:11:10.452Z DEBUG enrichment=started request=Zq77
2026-03-20T09:11:10.453Z INFO router=priority-fast -> fallback=priority-stable
2026-03-20T09:11:10.454Z INFO meter=emit tenant=null tokens=22 request=Zq77
2026-03-20T09:11:10.456Z INFO enrichment=complete tenant=org-x request=Zq77
2026-03-20T09:11:10.458Z INFO billing-event consumed tenant=org-x tokens=22 request=Zq77
```
rulia: meter emitted with tenant=null, then enrichment finished; downstream billing reconciler later attached org-x, but invoice-preview shows temporary spikes on the fallback route.
ben: That null emit is the crux. Our billing pipeline expects stable tenant field on ingest; reconciliations are working but preview layers don't ingest corrections in realtime.
marco: two axes: latency (can't block meter) vs correctness of preview. We could: a) attach a small preserver header (tenant-hint) at edge, b) mark early emits as "provisional" and surface in preview, c) buffer emits for N ms.
tia: buffering will add latency risk for fast tier. edge header sounds sensible but requires edge -> router -> meter pass-through guarantee. Might not cover requests where tenant is only determined by enrichment (no header).
ben: provisional flag + reconciliation seems least invasive. billing events would carry provisional=true and attribution_key. Reconciler emits correction events with correction=true and final=true. Preview should fold corrections in a streaming fashion.
ops-bot: MONITOR: billing-preview-anomaly service called 5x in last 20m for eu-west.
marco: We also need strong idempotency so corrections don't double-charge. Use a stable attribution_key (sha256 of request_id + session_id).
rulia: Agree. Also propose a small UX change: show a subtle badge in Console's invoice-preview rows that indicates "draft / provisional" with hover text explaining reconciliation timing.
tia: For telemetry, emit metrics: provisional_emits_total, provisional_corrections_total, late_enrichment_ms_histogram. We'll add alert if corrections > 0.2% of tokens for a tenant-week window.
ben: Operational playbook: enable provisional emits behind a router feature flag. Start 1% traffic shadow for 48h. After comparing preview diffs (expect <0.05%), widen to 10% for 72h and ramp if diffs stable. Rollback threshold 0.1% diffs per day or customer complaints. Ticket INF-5010 created.
marco: Who owns the preview ingestion change? It needs to accept correction events and apply them to the live preview aggregation.
rulia: That'll be the preview-service team (tia + julie?), tia you good to partner with preview folks?
tia: I can drive the change and add the metrics. I'll also add an opt-in tenant flag to expose provisional lines in the billing-export CSV for debug.
ben: One more: add a deterministic minimal schema change to billing-event: {request_id, attribution_key, provisional, original_route, tokens}. Keep schema backwards compatible.
marco: Good. Also add a short lived "orphan provisional ledger" for provisional emits so accounting queries for the interval are consistent. Reconciler will move tokens from orphan ledger -> tenant ledger atomically.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled canary window 2026-03-21 02:00-06:00 UTC.
rulia: I'll draft rollout docs and the customer-facing note explaining invoice-preview "drafts" semantics. Also coordinate support playbook.
marco: Assigning owners: infra=marco, meter+reconciler=ben, preview-ui=tia, rollout coordination=rulia. INF-5010 updated.
tia: Will open PRs for metrics and preview folding by EOD.
ben: I'll add reconciliation idempotency tests and a small producer-side circuit breaker to avoid emitting null tenant when enrichment still pending beyond 200ms.
rulia: Nice. Let's keep the initial canary tiny. If any tenant-level correction spike appears we'll pause. Thanks team :raised_hands:
